scientific_limitations: Curvature is computed only in nondegenerate curve-transverse directions at x=0; ambient Bergman form is everywhere degenerate, with rank zero on 2d+1 branch submanifolds. No assertion of sharpness outside this domain family or about positive-definite Bergman metrics. Priority uncertainty for older specialized gamma calculations.
title: Genus-four transverse curvature transition in finite-dimensional pseudoconvex Bergman examples
